baseline.equivalence_test: tests/test_q_ceasc.py and tests/test_q_ceasc_score.py preserve the single-view Q-CEASC contract

core_invariants: The plugin accepts only query, key, valid-mask, and entity-mask inputs; labels, targets, and model predictions never enter the gate.
The residual is finite, zero on invalid/entity positions, and zero-sum over active context positions.
Both views share the frozen action geometry but retain independent trainable quantum/control parameters.
The matched classical two-view control uses the same composition, parameter count, data, optimizer, and evaluation protocol.
The toy result cannot authorize a natural-task run, a collaborator handoff, an L2 claim, or a quantum-advantage claim.

interfaces.output_schema: residual (B,N) plus two-view agreement and gate diagnostics

invariants: query and key shapes are preserved

plugins.hypothesis: Single-view Q-CEASC supplies the positive carryover and the comparison reference.
Agreement between two independent label-free support views identifies when an out-of-span residual is reliable; abstaining on disagreement reduces seed-sensitive harmful interventions.
plugins.output_schema: finite context-only zero-sum residual, view agreement, gate, and per-view norms
plugins.resource_estimate: two Q-CEASC views; approximately 2x single-view parameter and circuit-simulation cost
failure_signatures: gate does not respond to context swap

shape_dtype_normalization: all tensors record shape and dtype

plugins.hypothesis: Any benefit from two-view agreement alone must be measured against an identical classical span composition.
plugins.output_schema: finite context-only zero-sum residual with the same agreement gate
failure_signatures: classical result omitted from the same trace

shape_dtype_normalization: use the same active-key centering and bounded gate as the quantum candidate

trace_contract.sample_selection_rule: Freeze the first training micro-batch and two generation fixtures before observing outputs; record a context-swapped mismatched-view diagnostic.
trace_contract.target_boundary: Synthetic target support is evaluation-only and never enters plugin inputs, agreement, gate, or trace-derived decisions.

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Per-case agreement, gate activity, mismatched-context response, and gated residual dispersion before any task-utility conclusion.

composition.merge_rule: Run the two views independently, compute bounded cosine agreement over active context keys, then scale their mean residual by the non-negative agreement gate.

validation.baseline_equivalence: Single-view Q-CEASC remains available and its existing tests must pass unchanged.
tests: two-view plugin can be disabled without changing the baseline
repeated toy runs reproduce the same trace
single-view, product-state, classical, shuffled-context, and fixed-bank controls are executed
two-view parameter count is matched between quantum and classical controls
permutation equivariance and empty-context fallback hold
agreement and gate are bounded and context-swap responsive
score wrapper preserves shape and zero-sum residual contract
toy runner emits sample-trace.v1 with training and generation stages

reproducibility.dataset_identity: synthetic Q-CEASC mechanism fixtures v1; frozen before outcomes
reproducibility.environment: Python >=3.10, torch >=2.0, CPU or one GPU toy only

limitations: The two-view gate is a new hypothesis, not evidence of task utility.
The toy uses exact statevector simulation and cannot establish hardware speedup.
The formal Q-CEASC report has only three seeds and incomplete semantic case traces.
Complete-data experiments remain collaborator-only after review and explicit promotion.
